audience: online stores that sync product feeds and marketplace orders through GoDataFeed

useCases.title: Check the feeds in a store
useCases.text: Count the product feeds first. Then list them with their names and status, and open one by its id.

useCases.title: Review orders not yet acknowledged
useCases.text: Count the orders in a purchase date range, then list the orders with status New. Open one order to read its items and status.

useCases.title: Look up shipments for an order
useCases.text: List the fulfillments recorded for one order, then open one to read its shipment details.

useCases.title: Acknowledge an order in your own system
useCases.text: Read the order, then acknowledge it with your own order number. The order moves to processing and the marketplace receives the number.

useCases.title: Record a shipment and its status
useCases.text: Record a fulfillment with a tracking number for one order, then set the order status to shipped. Both changes go to the marketplace.
